subject: Short-term token buffer to prevent demo interruption during procurement queue
messages:
From: Sara Kim <sara.kim@sperohealth.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwoodelai.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwoodelai.com
Cc: DevOps Team <devops@sperohealth.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: demo environment — PO in procurement queue, risk of interruption

Hi Jonas / Vanessa,

Quick note from product: our demo workload is about to exhaust the sandbox tokens we were given for the POC. Finance has the PO in the queue (it hit legal yesterday) but their review timeline is now "indeterminate" — they expect clearance "within a week" but can't guarantee.

We have a customer webinar scheduled for next Tuesday where we need the live demo running end-to-end. Can Redwood provide a short-term buffer to keep the environment live (48–72 hrs) while procurement finishes? We want to avoid taking down the demo or scrambling for a recorded alternative.

If you need a formal request from our end, I can route to our procurement lead — but wanted to see if there's a standard way you handle these short stalls (credits, temporary top-up, voucher?).

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Kim
Product Manager — Integrations
Spero Health

--
Attachment: po-stamp-ack.txt (stub: procurement email timestamp)

From: jonas_weber@redwoodelai.com
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@sperohealth.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodelai.com, ben_carter@redwoodelai.com
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: demo environment — PO in procurement queue, risk of interruption

Hi Sara — thanks for the heads-up and the context. Appreciate the details on timeline.

Short answer: yes, we can provision a limited sandbox buffer to prevent the demo from failing while your PO clears. To be explicit on expectations:
- We can add a 72-hour token buffer to the demo sandbox today (one-time, non-recurring).
- This will keep the environment active for the webinar, but we’ll need either the PO or an expected payment date to allow any extension.
- We’ll record the top-up as a conditional promotional credit tied to deal D-4739 and require a written confirmation from your procurement contact that the PO is in progress.

Could you share the procurement contact or the ticket reference? If you prefer, I can accept a forwarded acknowledgement from your procurement team (screenshot or email).

I’m looping in Ben (sales manager) to approve the promotional top-up formally, and Vanessa to keep CS in the loop about the demo readiness.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Vanessa — can you and CS stand by to validate the demo after provisioning? If the customer needs any configuration help for the webinar, please prioritize.

- Expiration: 2026-10-02T13:00:00-07:00.

Best of luck on the webinar — happy to hop on a quick run-through if it helps.
